_schema.purpose: Declare each bot's deployment mode so watchdog liveness checks match reality.

modes.systemd: Bot runs under a systemd unit. Liveness = `systemctl is-active <unit>`. Recovery = `sudo systemctl restart <unit>`.
modes.tmux-or-systemd: Bot may run in a tmux session OR a systemd unit. Liveness is satisfied if EITHER path is alive. Recovery defaults to the tmux launcher (the intended deployment) so two competing processes are not started.

_schema.default_mode_note: If a bot is missing from this file, watchdog assumes mode=systemd with unit `ourliberty-<agent>-bot.service` — preserves current behavior for beacon/forge/mirror should the file lose an entry.
_schema.doctrine: docs/runbooks/watchdog-bot-policy.md (rule + enforcement pairing per doctrine-of-doctrine, PR #163).
